stem:
Jacqueline works 5 days a week. She spends \( \frac{1}{3} \) of each day at work. The model is shaded to represent the amount of time Jacqueline spends at work each week.

Day 1 [shaded 1/3 of a rectangle]
Day 2 [shaded 1/3 of a rectangle]
Day 3 [shaded 1/3 of a rectangle]
Day 4 [shaded 1/3 of a rectangle]
Day 5 [shaded 1/3 of a rectangle]

KEY: [three empty boxes] = 1 day

Which expression can be used to determine the number of days Jacqueline works each week?
visual_elements: five rectangles each divided into three parts, with one part shaded per rectangle representing 1/3
